title: SEC0: No correctness bugs found
description:
All correctness checks passed:

1. FIPS gate: All entry points (sess_init, update, finalize, sess_reset) call wolfssl_fips_gate() first. SHA3-384 and SHA3-512 inherit gate via shared functions.

2. wolfCrypt return code convention: All checks use 'if (ret != 0)', never 'if (ret < 0)'. Lines 164, 264, 369, 433 in wolfssl_sha.c verified.

3. Paired Init/Free: 
   - sha_sess_init(): Lines 154, 157 initialize sha3-384/512
   - wolfssl_sha_sess_reset(): Lines 253-254, 257-258 properly Free then re-Init
   - wolfssl_sha_sess_free(): Lines 305-309 call Free for all types
   
4. Zeroization: Line 317 memzero_explicit(ctx) after all Free calls.

5. num_algos accuracy:
   - wolfssl_algo_list: 24 entries (line 85) - correct
   - kcapi_algo_list: 17 entries (line 48 kcapi_provider.c) - correct
   
6. Test vector byte counts:
   - SHA3-384: 48 bytes (6 rows × 8) - verified lines 81-88, 95-102, 123-130
   - SHA3-512: 64 bytes (8 rows × 8) - verified lines 152-161, 168-177, 198-207
   - 200-byte 0xa3 inputs present in both canonical vectors
   
7. Test digest reads:
   - test_chardev.c SHA3-384: Line 627 reads exactly 48 bytes
   - test_chardev.c SHA3-512: Line 708 reads exactly 64 bytes
   
8. Union field reuse: All switch statements (init, reset, update, finalize, free) use ctx->wc.sha3 consistently for SHA3 variants. No separate sha3_384 or sha3_512 fields.
